title: 〜んばかり(に/だ/の)
simpleExplanation: 〜んばかり describes something that looks as if it is about to happen: 泣かんばかりの顔 (a face that looks ready to cry), 割れんばかりの拍手 (applause as if the hall would split). The ん is the classical volitional attached to the ない-stem. The special phrase 言わんばかりに means "as if to say".
whenUsed: Narrative writing and vivid description, also in refined speech. It describes what the speaker observes in others or in scenes, not the speaker's own actions. する becomes せんばかり.
formation: Vない-stem + んばかりに + V (manner)
Vない-stem + んばかりの + N
Vない-stem + んばかりだ (sentence end)
Set: 言わんばかりに / 〜と言わんばかりの

steps.en: a face that looks like crying (neutral)
a face as if about to burst into tears (vivid, literary)

steps.ja: 「出て行け」と言わんばかりの態度
steps.en: an attitude as if to say "get out"

examples.ja: 彼女は泣かんばかりの顔で助けを求めた。
examples.reading: かのじょはなかんばかりのかおでたすけをもとめた。
examples.en: She asked for help with a face that looked ready to burst into tears.
examples.note: 泣かんばかりの + 顔: adnominal use.

examples.ja: 会場は割れんばかりの拍手に包まれた。
examples.reading: かいじょうはわれんばかりのはくしゅにつつまれた。
examples.en: The hall was filled with thunderous applause.
examples.note: 割れんばかりの拍手: the classic phrase for thunderous applause.

examples.ja: 彼は早く帰れと言わんばかりに、時計を見た。
examples.reading: かれははやくかえれといわんばかりに、とけいをみた。
examples.en: He looked at his watch as if to say hurry up and go home.
examples.note: 言わんばかりに: as if to say, with the implied words before it.

examples.ja: 彼女は飛び上がらんばかりに喜んだ。
examples.reading: かのじょはとびあがらんばかりによろこんだ。
examples.en: She was so delighted she almost jumped for joy.
examples.note: んばかりに + verb describes the manner.

examples.ja: 店員は「早く帰れ」と言わんばかりに、店の灯りを消し始めた。
examples.reading: てんいんは「はやくかえれ」といわんばかりに、みせのあかりをけしはじめた。
examples.en: The clerk started turning off the shop lights as if to say "hurry up and leave".
examples.note: The quoted words are what the behaviour implies.

similarGrammar.difference: Same classical ん, but expresses purpose.
Same ん: "be about to / try to" as an actual imminent event, not an appearance.
"As if to say X": the quoted version, close to 言わんばかりに.

commonMistakes.why: Attach ん to the ない-stem.

commonMistakes.wrong: 私は泣かんばかりに頼んだ。
commonMistakes.right: 私は泣きそうになりながら頼んだ。
commonMistakes.why: The pattern describes what is observed in others; for oneself it sounds odd.
ばかり alone means "only"; the ん is essential.

usageNotes: The event does not actually happen; it only looks as if it will (the applause does not split the hall).
Frequent phrases: 割れんばかりの拍手, 泣かんばかり, あふれんばかりの笑顔, 言わんばかり.
する → せんばかり: 土下座せんばかりに謝った.
jlptTips: A ない-stem + ん + blank + の/に describing a vivid appearance → ばかり.
Distractors: んがため (purpose), んとする (imminent), ばかりに (because). Check for the ん and for the sense "as if".
言わんばかり is a frequent key; recognise it as a unit.
